title: Google\Cloud\Trace\V2\StackTrace
name: StackTrace
description: A call stack appearing in a trace.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.stack_frames
params.description: Stack frames in this stack trace. A maximum of 128 frames are allowed.

params.name: data.stack_trace_hash_id
params.description: The hash ID is used to conserve network bandwidth for duplicate stack traces within a single trace. Often multiple spans will have identical stack traces. The first occurrence of a stack trace should contain both the stackFrame content and a value in stackTraceHashId. Subsequent spans within the same request can refer to that stack trace by only setting stackTraceHashId.

methods.name: getStackFrames
methods.description: Stack frames in this stack trace. A maximum of 128 frames are allowed.

methods.name: setStackFrames
methods.description: Stack frames in this stack trace. A maximum of 128 frames are allowed.

methods.name: getStackTraceHashId
methods.description: The hash ID is used to conserve network bandwidth for duplicate stack traces within a single trace.

methods.name: setStackTraceHashId
methods.description: The hash ID is used to conserve network bandwidth for duplicate stack traces within a single trace.
